goal: Deliver the SDA-v1 draft for SDA-M08-INT — Integrated design, reference solution and decision summary

in_scope:
**Integrated design exercise:** Compute ranked category totals and query a sharded index under one slow shard.

**Reference solution and self-evaluation:** Reference package: map/shuffle/reduce records, event-time policy, index layout, deadlines and merge rules; assess skew and incomplete-result semantics.

**Synthesis outcome map:** M08-S1: trace ranking records and defend freshness and partial-search-result policy. M08-EX1 measures this synthesis outcome using M08-L01-LO1, M08-L02-LO2 and M08-L03-LO2. It does not claim all module lesson outcomes. Each lesson’s separate companion remains responsible for its complete LO1/LO2 assessment, and the course portfolio must reconcile all companions before course completion.

**Decision-summary table plan:** Choose batch versus streaming and full versus partial results by freshness, correctness and tail-latency goals. Each eventual row states trigger, option, mechanism, benefit, cost, failure signal, when to avoid, and the lesson reference.
out_of_scope: Other Stories, approved curriculum changes, merge and publication.

constraints: GitHub Issue #97 coordinates ownership. Codex is the active writer on codex/drafts-sda-ms05.
Use the approved SDA-v1 outline and canonical backlog paths. Write original English drafts for middle and senior engineers.
Separate instructional content from assessment, cite primary sources at claim level, and label scenario assumptions.

definition_of_done.text: Record claim-level source evidence with precise sections, version scope and limitations.
Deliver completed teaching and assessment drafts at every declared canonical output path.

acceptance_criteria.text: Support each material factual claim with exact primary evidence or identify it as a scenario assumption or inference.
Implement the approved module synthesis subset and its reference/self-evaluation plan.
Decision-summary table includes trigger, option, mechanism, benefit, cost, failure signal, when to avoid and lesson reference.
Consolidate current teaching evidence for each assigned topic and reconcile every lesson and module synthesis outcome with its assessment evidence.
Trace the mechanism and failures, teach each mapped outcome, and define any user-facing success measurement over original operations.
